title.narrative: Empowering Grassroots CSOs, Youth, and Women to advance accountability, good governance, and inclusive civic engagement.

description.narrative: The project is part of the EU CSF Plus Programme titled “Strengthening the Capacities of Grassroots CSOs in Ethiopia.” It aims to enhance the capacity, independence, and credibility of grassroots CSOs, youth, and women groups to promote accountability, inclusive civic engagement, and democratic local governance in Basketo Zone by 2027. The action is to achieve the following key objectives: To strengthen the organizational, technical, and leadership capacities of 10 grassroots CSOs in Basketo Special Zone so that 70% of them adopt and applY improved governance, financial management, safeguarding, and M&E systems to operate independently and effectively engage in local governance processes. To increase the meaningful participation of 200 women and youth (70% women) in civic engagement and public decision-making processes. To promote transparency and accountability by supporting CSO-led social accountability initiatives, including the application of Community Scorecards in 4 public services, resulting in 80% of identified service delivery issues addressed through agreed action plans. Establish and operationalize one functional multi-stakeholder CSO coalition platform, facilitating 8 structured dialogue sessions and 4 joint advocacy or action initiatives among grassroots CSOs, women and youth groups, and local government actors to advance inclusive and participatory governance.
